name: Onee-sama no ♂ (Are) ~Moegi Shinku no Junan!?~
original_name: お姉さまの♂（アレ）～萌木深紅の受難!?～
source:
Shinku is a high school student and respected by other students. But one day, she suddenly gets a dick!? She is confused what to do, but her friends welcome it! Like this, her harem life starts all of a sudden. What will happen to Shinku's school life...?
